subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should Android Talk/Voice follow the selected Chat session/agent, expose its own Talk-specific selector, or use another cross-companion-app target rule?
rationale: The remaining work changes user-visible voice routing and session identity semantics across companion apps, and the safest implementation depends on the intended UX contract rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Follow Chat Target
options.body: Make Talk/Voice use the active Chat session or selected agent, matching the iOS/macOS direction and avoiding a second source of truth.

options.title: Separate Talk Picker
options.body: Add an independent Talk/Voice selector so users can keep voice and text conversations on different agents, with explicit UI state and persistence.

options.title: Close As TTS-Only
options.body: Declare only the per-agent TTS half in scope and reject companion-app Talk target selection for now, leaving Android voice pinned to the default session.

recommendation.title: Follow Chat Target
recommendation.body: Make Talk/Voice use the active Chat session or selected agent, matching the iOS/macOS direction and avoiding a second source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete scoped the issue in comments, landed the TTS half, and is the clearest available routing owner for the product-direction choice.
